description: Run a video VFX preset on a whole clip. Today only 'gesichter_verpixeln' (pixelate every face) is live. Costs credits per frame — call with dry_run=true first to see the price. With rerender_from (a finished job_id) it re-renders for free with other settings, e.g. exceptions: object ids that stay sharp. Tell the person: "Pixelated automatically, not guaranteed to catch everything — check before publishing." Poll lab_vfx_preset_status until done|failed.

ausnahmen.description: Object ids to leave unpixelated (rerender only)

rerender_from.description: job_id of a finished run to re-render for free

video_url.description: HTTPS URL of the clip (project asset)
